senses.zh: 开始；机会；通路；空缺的职位

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9

senses.zh: 音乐会用的；在音乐会上演出的

ex.en: We enjoyed an outdoor concert in the park yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在公园欣赏了一场露天音乐会。

ex.en: Free public concerts can make cultural activities more accessible and encourage residents to use shared urban spaces.
ex.zh: 免费公共音乐会能让更多人参与文化活动，并鼓励居民使用城市公共空间。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。去听音乐会用 go to a concert。

ex.en: The headmaster welcomed new pupils at the school gate.
ex.zh: 男校长在校门口迎接新生。

ex.en: The headmaster introduced a mentoring programme to help younger pupils develop confidence and settle into school life.
ex.zh: 男校长推行了一项辅导计划，帮助低年级学生建立信心并适应学校生活。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。指男性；英式headteacher不分性别，美式常用principal。

ex.en: The outdoor concert was our town's biggest summer event.
ex.zh: 这场户外音乐会是我们镇上夏季最大的活动。

ex.en: Hosting a major cultural event can boost local tourism, although the financial benefits may be unevenly distributed.
ex.zh: 举办大型文化活动可以促进当地旅游业，但经济收益的分配可能不均。

col: in the event of｜万一发生
tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。in the event of后接名词，意为“万一发生”。

ex.en: Each guest brought a dish to share at dinner.
ex.zh: 每位客人都带了一道菜，在晚餐时与大家分享。

ex.en: Hotels can encourage guests to conserve water by offering towel replacement only when requested.
ex.zh: 酒店可以仅在住客提出要求时更换毛巾，以鼓励节水。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。guest可指受邀客人，也可指付费的酒店住客。

senses.zh: 将…列入表中；将…排入日程表

ex.en: I marked our camping weekend on the kitchen calendar.
ex.zh: 我在厨房的日历上标出了周末露营的日子。

ex.en: Schools should publish an annual calendar so families can plan holidays around important educational events.
ex.zh: 学校应公布年度日程表，方便家庭避开重要教学活动来安排假期。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。calendar year指一月至十二月，不等于学年。

ex.en: The cat usually sleeps indoors during the daytime.
ex.zh: 这只猫白天通常在屋里睡觉。

ex.en: Higher daytime temperatures may force outdoor workers to adjust their schedules during the summer months.
ex.zh: 夏季白天气温升高，可能迫使户外工作者调整工作时间。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。常说in the daytime；作定语时不加the。

ex.en: Our team meeting starts right after lunch today.
ex.zh: 我们团队今天午饭后马上开会。

ex.en: Regular meetings between teachers and parents can help identify learning difficulties at an early stage.
ex.zh: 教师与家长定期会面有助于及早发现学习困难。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。参加会议用attend a meeting；meeting也可指会面。

ex.en: We watched a video of penguins sliding across ice.
ex.zh: 我们看了一段企鹅在冰上滑行的视频。

ex.en: Educational video can make complex processes easier to understand, especially for students with limited background knowledge.
ex.zh: 教学视频可以让复杂的过程更容易理解，对背景知识有限的学生尤其如此。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。一段视频用a video；泛指视频媒介时可不可数。

senses.zh: 组织；使有系统化；给予生机；组织成立工会等

ex.en: Our neighbours organized a picnic by the river.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居组织了一次河边野餐。

ex.en: Schools should organize practical workshops that help students develop communication skills and prepare for employment.
ex.zh: 学校应组织实践工作坊，帮助学生培养沟通技能并为就业做好准备。

col: organize your time｜合理安排时间
tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。英式也常拼作organise；organize是规范拼写。

senses.zh: 组织（等于organize）；有机化；给予生机

ex.en: We organise a picnic for our neighbours every summer.
ex.zh: 我们每年夏天都会为邻居们组织一次野餐。

ex.en: Local councils can organise community workshops to teach residents practical ways to reduce household waste.
ex.zh: 地方议会可以组织社区工作坊，教居民减少家庭垃圾的实用方法。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。organise常见于英式英语；美式通常写organize。

senses.zh: 马铃薯片; 炸土豆片( potato chip的名词复数 )

tip: 📘 8A Unit 10

senses.zh: 巧克力，巧克力糖；巧克力色
巧克力色的；巧克力口味的

ex.en: He shared a bar of chocolate with his sister.
ex.zh: 他和妹妹分享了一块巧克力。

ex.en: Consumers increasingly expect chocolate producers to ensure fair wages and safe working conditions throughout their supply chains.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越期望巧克力生产商确保整个供应链中的公平工资和安全工作条件。

col: a bar of chocolate｜一块巧克力
a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力糖
tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。食材巧克力不可数；单颗巧克力糖可数。

ex.en: Lena felt upset when she lost her favourite scarf.
ex.zh: 莉娜丢了最喜欢的围巾，心里很难过。

ex.en: Sudden changes to school routines can upset younger children, who often rely on predictable daily activities.
ex.zh: 学校作息突然改变可能让年幼的孩子不安，因为他们往往依赖可预期的日常活动。

col: upset someone's plans｜打乱某人的计划
tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。动词过去式、过去分词仍是upset；名词重音在前。

ex.en: We took a taxi home with our heavy bags.
ex.zh: 我们带着沉重的行李，打车回了家。

ex.en: Improving public transport could reduce dependence on taxis and private cars in crowded city centres.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以减少人们在拥挤的市中心对出租车和私家车的依赖。

col: hail a taxi｜招手叫出租车
tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。乘出租车可说take a taxi或by taxi。

ex.en: Your advice helped me choose a comfortable bicycle.
ex.zh: 你的建议帮我选到了一辆骑着舒服的自行车。

ex.en: Schools should provide practical career advice so that students can make informed decisions about their future.
ex.zh: 学校应提供实用的职业建议，让学生能够对自己的未来作出明智决定。

col: a piece of advice｜一条建议
tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。不可数，不用an advice；动词advise末尾读/z/。

ex.en: We usually travel by train to visit our grandparents.
ex.zh: 我们通常坐火车去看望祖父母。

ex.en: Affordable public transport enables residents to travel more sustainably and reduces dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 价格合理的公共交通让居民能够以更可持续的方式出行，并减少对私家车的依赖。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。泛指旅行时travel不可数；一次旅行用a trip。

senses.zh: 代理人，代理商；药剂；特工

ex.en: The travel agent found us a cheaper flight home.
ex.zh: 旅行代理人为我们找到了更便宜的回程航班。

ex.en: Local community groups can act as agents of change by encouraging residents to adopt more sustainable habits.
ex.zh: 当地社区团体可以鼓励居民养成更可持续的生活习惯，从而推动变革。

col: an agent of change｜变革推动者
tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。agent不只指特工；cleaning agent中的agent指剂。

ex.en: We asked an expert to examine the old painting.
ex.zh: 我们请了一位专家来鉴定这幅旧画。

ex.en: Schools should seek expert advice before introducing new technology into classrooms to support student learning.
ex.zh: 学校在将新技术引入课堂以辅助学生学习之前，应征求专家意见。

col: an expert on｜某方面的专家
tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。expert on/in表示某领域的专家。

senses.zh: 强调；紧贴；秘而不宣；独自承受
保守秘密；不与人来往；不与他人交往

tip: 📘 8A Unit 10

senses.zh: 十几岁的青少年；十三岁到十九岁的少年

ex.en: As a teenager, I cycled to school every day.
ex.zh: 我十几岁时每天骑自行车上学。

ex.en: Schools should provide spaces where teenagers can discuss their concerns and receive support from trained staff.
ex.zh: 学校应提供场所，让青少年能够讨论自己的困扰，并获得受过培训的工作人员的支持。

col: a young teenager｜十三四岁的青少年
as a teenager｜在青少年时期
tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。特指13至19岁的人，不泛指所有未成年人。

ex.en: It is normal to feel nervous before an interview.
ex.zh: 面试前感到紧张是正常的。

ex.en: Flexible working hours are becoming a normal feature of employment in many sectors of the economy.
ex.zh: 弹性工作时间正成为许多经济领域中常见的用工安排。

col: normal working hours｜正常工作时间
tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。normal强调符合常态；ordinary强调普通、不特别。

ex.en: We will eat outside unless it starts to rain.
ex.zh: 除非开始下雨，否则我们就在外面吃饭。

ex.en: Public transport will remain unpopular unless local authorities improve its reliability and make fares more affordable.
ex.zh: 除非地方政府提高公共交通的可靠性并降低票价，否则它仍不会受欢迎。

col: unless otherwise stated｜除非另有说明
unless absolutely necessary｜除非绝对必要
unless circumstances change｜除非情况有变
tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。表将来条件时，unless从句通常用一般现在时。

ex.en: This warm coat will certainly keep you comfortable outside.
ex.zh: 这件暖和的大衣肯定能让你在外面也舒舒服服的。

ex.en: Improved public transport would certainly benefit commuters, although its success would depend on reliable services and affordable fares.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通无疑会惠及通勤者，但成效取决于服务是否可靠、票价是否合理。

col: will certainly help｜肯定会有帮助
tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。常置于实义动词前、be后；也可单独礼貌回应请求。

ex.en: I left my wallet beside the kitchen sink.
ex.zh: 我把钱包落在厨房水槽旁了。

ex.en: As digital payments become more common, fewer consumers need to carry cash in a wallet.
ex.zh: 随着数字支付日益普及，需要在钱包里携带现金的消费者越来越少。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。wallet通常指放纸币和卡片的折叠式钱包。

senses.zh: 英里；一英里赛跑；较大的距离

ex.en: The nearest swimming pool is only a mile away.
ex.zh: 最近的游泳池只有一英里远。

ex.en: Replacing short car journeys with walking even one mile could improve public health and reduce emissions.
ex.zh: 用步行替代短途驾车，哪怕只走一英里，也能改善公众健康并减少排放。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。英里是距离单位；mile可数，复数加s。

senses.zh: 生气的；愤怒的；狂暴的；（伤口等）发炎的

ex.en: He felt angry when someone damaged his bicycle.
ex.zh: 有人弄坏了他的自行车，他感到很生气。

ex.en: Residents became angry about the council's decision to close the only library in their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 市政委员会决定关闭社区唯一的图书馆，居民们对此感到愤怒。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。生某人的气用angry with；因某事生气用about。

senses.zh: 了解的；聪明的；有理解力的

ex.en: Thanks for your understanding when I arrived late yesterday.
ex.zh: 谢谢你体谅我昨天迟到的事。

ex.en: Learning another language can deepen students' understanding of different cultures and encourage greater respect for others.
ex.zh: 学习另一种语言可以加深学生对不同文化的理解，并促进对他人的尊重。

col: a clear understanding of｜对……的清楚理解
an understanding friend｜善解人意的朋友
tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。表示“对……的理解”用understanding of。

senses.zh: 粗心的；无忧无虑的；淡漠的

ex.en: I was careless and left my keys in the door.
ex.zh: 我一时粗心，把钥匙留在了门上。

ex.en: Careless disposal of household waste can pollute local waterways and create serious risks for wildlife.
ex.zh: 随意丢弃生活垃圾会污染当地水道，并给野生动物带来严重风险。

col: a careless mistake｜粗心造成的错误
tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。careless是粗心的；carefree才是无忧无虑的。

ex.en: I took your umbrella by mistake this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我误拿了你的伞。

ex.en: Teachers should encourage students to learn from mistakes rather than feel ashamed of making them.
ex.zh: 教师应鼓励学生从错误中学习，而不是因为犯错而感到羞愧。

col: learn from mistakes｜从错误中学习
mistake A for B｜把A误认成B
tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。说make a mistake，不说do；动词过去式为mistook。
📘 8A Unit 10

ex.en: Be careful with that bowl; it belonged to Grandma.
ex.zh: 小心拿那个碗，那是奶奶以前用的。

ex.en: Careful planning can help cities expand public transport while keeping construction costs under control.
ex.zh: 周密的规划可以帮助城市扩展公共交通，同时控制建设成本。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。be careful with后接物；be careful to后接动词。

senses.zh: 建议；劝告，忠告；通知；警告

ex.en: The doctor advised me to rest for a few days.
ex.zh: 医生建议我休息几天。

ex.en: Schools should advise students on career options before they choose subjects for further study.
ex.zh: 学校应在学生选择进修科目之前，就职业选择向他们提供建议。

col: advise someone to do something｜建议某人做某事
tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。advise是动词；advice是不可数名词，词尾发/s/。

ex.en: We solved the puzzle together after dinner last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚晚饭后，我们一起解开了那道谜题。

ex.en: Improving public transport could help solve traffic problems in rapidly growing urban areas.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通有助于解决快速发展城区的交通问题。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。solve直接接问题；“溶解”用dissolve。

ex.en: Take one step forward and close the door.
ex.zh: 向前迈一步，把门关上。

ex.en: Improving public transport is an important step towards reducing traffic congestion and air pollution in cities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通是减少城市交通拥堵和空气污染的重要一步。

col: take a step｜迈一步；采取措施
tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。take steps to do sth表示“采取措施做某事”。

ex.en: I trust my neighbour to feed our cat.
ex.zh: 我信得过邻居，放心让他喂我们的猫。

ex.en: Public trust in scientific advice depends partly on how clearly researchers communicate uncertainty and evidence.
ex.zh: 公众对科学建议的信任，部分取决于研究人员能否清晰地说明不确定性和证据。

col: trust someone to do something｜相信某人会做某事
a charitable trust｜慈善信托机构
tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。trust sb to do sth表示相信某人能可靠地做某事。

ex.en: My sister has years of experience repairing old bicycles.
ex.zh: 我姐姐有多年修理旧自行车的经验。

ex.en: Work experience can help graduates develop practical skills that employers value alongside academic qualifications.
ex.zh: 工作经验能帮助毕业生培养实践技能，而雇主不仅重视学历，也看重这些技能。

col: a rewarding experience｜有收获的经历
tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。表“经验”不可数；表具体“经历”可数。

senses.zh: 分成两半；一半；把……切成两半

tip: 📘 8A Unit 10
📘 8A Unit 10

ex.en: Would you like anything else with your soup?
ex.zh: 除了汤，你还想要点别的吗？

ex.en: Governments must improve public transport, or else growing traffic congestion may undermine the economic benefits of urban development.
ex.zh: 政府必须改善公共交通，否则日益严重的交通拥堵可能削弱城市发展带来的经济效益。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。放在不定代词或疑问词后，如someone else。
📘 8A Unit 10

senses.en: to chase wild animals to catch or kill them
to search carefully for someone or something
an organised search or an activity involving chasing wild animals

ex.en: We hunted for my keys under the sofa.
ex.zh: 我们在沙发底下找我的钥匙。

ex.en: When natural habitats shrink, predators may hunt closer to farms, increasing conflict between wildlife and local communities.
ex.zh: 自然栖息地缩小时，捕食动物可能到更靠近农场的地方捕猎，加剧野生动物与当地社区的冲突。

col: hunt wild animals｜猎捕野生动物
tip: 📘 8A Unit 10。猎捕动物可直接接宾语；寻找物品常用hunt for。

ex.en: We can discuss this matter after lunch today.
ex.zh: 我们可以今天午饭后讨论这件事。

ex.en: The quality of teaching matters more than expensive equipment when schools aim to improve student achievement.
ex.zh: 学校若想提高学生成绩，教学质量比昂贵的设备更重要。

col: a matter of time｜时间问题
tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。指事情时通常可数；指物质时不可数；作动词表示要紧。
📘 8B Unit 1

senses.zh: 疼痛的，痛心的；剧烈的，极度的；恼火的，发怒的；厉害的，迫切的

ex.en: My legs are sore after yesterday's long walk.
ex.zh: 昨天走了很远的路，我的腿现在酸痛。

ex.en: Office workers may develop sore muscles if they remain seated without taking regular breaks.
ex.zh: 上班族如果久坐而不定时休息，可能会出现肌肉酸痛。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。sore常修饰身体部位，如a sore throat。
📘 8B Unit 1
📘 8B Unit 1
📘 8B Unit 1

ex.en: A tiny stone in my shoe hurt my foot.
ex.zh: 鞋里的一颗小石子硌疼了我的脚。

ex.en: Making essential services accessible on foot can encourage physical activity and reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 让人们步行就能获得基本服务，可以促进身体活动并减少对私家车的依赖。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。脚和英尺的复数均为feet；步行用on foot。

senses.zh: 使变细；与…搂著脖子亲吻

ex.en: He wrapped a warm scarf around his neck.
ex.zh: 他在脖子上围了一条暖和的围巾。

ex.en: Office workers may experience neck pain if their computer screens are positioned at an unsuitable height.
ex.zh: 如果电脑屏幕的高度不合适，办公室职员可能会感到颈部疼痛。

col: the neck of a bottle｜瓶颈
tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。neck指脖子；throat指喉咙，勿混用。

ex.en: My stomach started rumbling while I was cooking dinner.
ex.zh: 我做晚饭时，肚子开始咕咕叫。

ex.en: Eating regular meals may help prevent stomach discomfort and support healthy eating habits among students.
ex.zh: 规律进餐可能有助于预防胃部不适，并帮助学生养成健康的饮食习惯。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。表示“忍受”时，常用于 can't stomach 结构。

ex.en: My throat felt dry after talking all afternoon.
ex.zh: 说了一下午话后，我觉得喉咙很干。

ex.en: Poor air quality can irritate the throat and worsen breathing problems, particularly among children and older adults.
ex.zh: 空气质量差会刺激咽喉并加重呼吸问题，儿童和老年人尤其容易受到影响。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。喉咙痛用have a sore throat，注意冠词a。

senses.zh: 使发烧；使狂热；使患热病

ex.en: He stayed in bed because he had a fever.
ex.zh: 他因为发烧而卧床休息。

ex.en: A persistent fever may indicate an infection and should be assessed by a qualified healthcare professional.
ex.zh: 持续发热可能意味着感染，应由合格的医疗专业人员进行评估。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。表示发烧常说have a fever，也可说have a temperature。

ex.en: I like to lie on the grass after lunch.
ex.zh: 我喜欢午饭后躺在草地上。

ex.en: Advertisements that lie about environmental benefits can undermine public trust and discourage genuinely sustainable purchasing decisions.
ex.zh: 就环保效益撒谎的广告会损害公众信任，并阻碍真正可持续的购买决策。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。躺：lie–lay–lain；说谎：lie–lied–lied。
📘 8B Unit 1

senses.zh: 休息，静止；休息时间；剩余部分；支架
使休息，使轻松；把…寄托于

ex.en: Let's have a rest under that shady tree.
ex.zh: 我们在那棵树荫下休息一下吧。

ex.en: Regular periods of rest can help employees maintain concentration and reduce the risk of workplace accidents.
ex.zh: 定期休息有助于员工保持专注，并降低工作场所发生事故的风险。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。the rest of后接名词，谓语单复数随所指内容变化。

ex.en: The dusty room made me cough several times.
ex.zh: 房间里的灰尘让我咳嗽了好几次。

ex.en: People with a persistent cough should seek medical advice, particularly if symptoms interfere with sleep or daily activities.
ex.zh: 持续咳嗽的人应就医咨询，尤其是在症状影响睡眠或日常活动时。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。gh在此发/f/；have a cough表示有咳嗽症状。

ex.en: My toothache kept me awake for most of the night.
ex.zh: 牙痛让我大半夜都没睡着。

ex.en: Affordable dental services allow people with toothache to seek treatment before more serious problems develop.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的牙科服务让牙痛患者能在问题恶化前就医。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。英式常说have toothache，美式常说have a toothache。

senses.zh: 测量体温；给某人量体温；给某人体温

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1

senses.zh: 头痛；麻烦；令人头痛之事

ex.en: I have a headache, so I need some quiet.
ex.zh: 我头痛，需要安静一会儿。

ex.en: Ageing transport infrastructure has become a major headache for local authorities facing increasingly limited budgets.
ex.zh: 对于预算日益紧张的地方政府而言，老化的交通基础设施已成为一大难题。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。表示一次头痛用a headache，通常说have a headache。
📘 8B Unit 1

senses.zh: 休息一下；休息了一会儿；轻松一刻

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1

senses.zh: 使受伤；损害；使疼痛；使痛心
感到疼痛；有坏处；带来痛苦

ex.en: My ankle still hurts when I climb the stairs.
ex.zh: 我上楼梯时，脚踝还是疼。

ex.en: Cuts to public transport funding may hurt rural communities that depend on buses for essential journeys.
ex.zh: 削减公共交通经费可能损害依赖公交出行办理必要事务的农村社区的利益。

col: hurt someone's feelings｜伤害某人的感情
tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。过去式和过去分词均为 hurt；疼痛部位可作主语。

senses.zh: 旅客；乘客；过路人；碍手碍脚的人

ex.en: A passenger left a blue umbrella on the bus.
ex.zh: 一位乘客把一把蓝色雨伞落在了公交车上。

ex.en: Improved rail services could increase passenger numbers and reduce reliance on private cars.
ex.zh: 改善铁路服务可以增加乘客数量，减少人们对私家车的依赖。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。指乘坐交通工具的人，不包括驾驶员或机组人员。

ex.en: The dog ran off when the gate opened.
ex.zh: 门一开，那只狗就跑走了。

ex.en: Keeping unnecessary lights off in public buildings can reduce electricity consumption and lower operating costs.
ex.zh: 关闭公共建筑内不必要的照明可以减少耗电量并降低运营成本。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。off强调离开或关闭；of常表示所属，勿混淆。

senses.zh: 下车；脱下(衣服等)；脱(衣)；下(马)

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1

senses.zh: 使……惊讶的是；竟然；让某人惊讶的是

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1

senses.zh: 在…之上；对…了解；映射到…上

ex.en: The cat jumped onto the sofa beside me.
ex.zh: 猫跳到我旁边的沙发上。

ex.en: Moving freight onto trains could reduce road congestion and lower emissions from the transport sector.
ex.zh: 将货物转移到火车上运输，可以缓解道路拥堵并降低运输业的排放。

col: load goods onto｜把货物装到……上
tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。onto强调移动到表面；on常表示已在上面。

ex.en: We had trouble opening the stiff kitchen window.
ex.zh: 厨房的窗户很紧，我们费了好大劲才打开。

ex.en: Many older adults have trouble accessing public services that are available only through digital platforms.
ex.zh: 许多老年人难以使用那些仅通过数字平台提供的公共服务。

col: have trouble doing something｜做某事有困难
take the trouble to do something｜费心做某事
tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。表示做某事有困难，用have trouble doing。

senses.zh: 打；打击；（演出等）成功；讽刺
打击；袭击；碰撞；偶然发现；伤…的感情

ex.en: The ball hit the fence and bounced towards me.
ex.zh: 球撞上围栏，又朝我弹了过来。

ex.en: Rising energy prices have hit small businesses particularly hard, forcing many owners to reduce their operating hours.
ex.zh: 能源价格上涨对小企业的打击尤其严重，迫使许多经营者缩短营业时间。

col: a big hit｜大受欢迎的事物
tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。过去式、过去分词仍为hit；现在分词为hitting。
📘 8B Unit 1
📘 8B Unit 1

senses.zh: 她自己（she的反身代词）；她亲自

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1

ex.en: The nurse wrapped a clean bandage around my ankle.
ex.zh: 护士用干净的绷带包住了我的脚踝。

ex.en: Basic first aid courses teach people how to apply a bandage safely before professional help arrives.
ex.zh: 基础急救课程教人们如何在专业救援到来前安全地使用绷带。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。既是名词也是动词；bandage a wound意为包扎伤口。

senses.zh: 压；按；新闻；出版社； 印刷机

ex.en: Press this button to open the garage door.
ex.zh: 按这个按钮就能打开车库门。

ex.en: A free press helps citizens understand public affairs and holds those in power accountable.
ex.zh: 自由的新闻界帮助公民了解公共事务，并监督掌权者承担责任。

col: freedom of the press｜新闻自由
tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。表示新闻界通常用the press；按按钮不用push down。

senses.zh: 厌恶的；病态的；不舒服；渴望的；恶心的 ；生病的

ex.en: He stayed in bed because he felt sick this morning.
ex.zh: 他今天早上觉得不舒服，所以一直躺在床上。

ex.en: Paid sick leave allows employees to recover at home and reduces the spread of infections in workplaces.
ex.zh: 带薪病假让员工能在家康复，并减少感染在工作场所传播。

col: call in sick｜打电话请病假
tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。英式英语中be sick常指呕吐，feel sick常指恶心。

ex.en: She bent her knee gently before starting the exercise.
ex.zh: 开始锻炼前，她轻轻弯了弯膝盖。

ex.en: Regular low-impact exercise can strengthen the muscles around the knee and help maintain mobility in older adults.
ex.zh: 经常进行低冲击运动可以增强膝关节周围的肌肉，帮助老年人保持行动能力。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。词首k不发音；复数knees读作/niːz/。
📘 8B Unit 1

senses.zh: 呼吸；低语；松口气；（风）轻拂
呼吸；使喘息；流露；低声说

ex.en: Sit by the window and breathe slowly for a minute.
ex.zh: 坐在窗边，缓缓呼吸一分钟。

ex.en: People living near busy roads often breathe polluted air, which can increase their risk of respiratory illness.
ex.zh: 住在繁忙道路附近的人经常吸入受污染的空气，这可能增加他们患呼吸系统疾病的风险。

col: breathe fresh air｜呼吸新鲜空气
tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。breathe是动词，末音/ð/；breath是名词，末音/θ/。
📘 8B Unit 1

ex.en: We saw ourselves reflected in the clear lake.
ex.zh: 我们看到了自己映在清澈湖水中的倒影。

ex.en: By involving ourselves in community projects, we can develop practical skills and strengthen local relationships.
ex.zh: 通过参与社区项目，我们可以培养实用技能并增进邻里关系。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。by ourselves可指独自，也可指不靠别人。

senses.zh: 登山者；攀缘植物；尽力改善自己社会地位的人

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1
📘 8B Unit 1

ex.en: Wear sturdy shoes to reduce the risk of slipping.
ex.zh: 穿结实的鞋子可以降低滑倒的风险。

ex.en: Governments should assess the risk of flooding before approving new housing developments near rivers.
ex.zh: 政府在批准河流附近的新住宅开发项目之前，应评估洪水风险。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。risk后接名词或动名词，不接to do。

senses.zh: 冒风险；勇于冒险；承担风险

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1

senses.zh: 冒险；承保…的险；承受保险
承担风险；先人一步冒险；冒风险

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1

senses.zh: 事故；意外； 意外事件；机遇

ex.en: Luckily, nobody was hurt in the accident outside our house.
ex.zh: 幸好，我们家外面发生的事故没有造成人员受伤。

ex.en: Better street lighting can reduce the risk of accidents involving cyclists and pedestrians at night.
ex.zh: 改善街道照明可以降低夜间涉及骑车人和行人的事故风险。

col: a road accident｜道路交通事故
tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。by accident表示无意中，反义短语是on purpose。

ex.en: We faced a difficult situation when our car broke down.
ex.zh: 汽车抛锚时，我们陷入了困境。

ex.en: The housing situation has become increasingly difficult for young people living in major cities.
ex.zh: 对居住在大城市的年轻人来说，住房形势已变得日益严峻。

col: deal with a situation｜应对某种情况
tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。表示处于某种情况，用in a situation。

ex.en: Could I have half a kilo of tomatoes, please?
ex.zh: 请给我半公斤西红柿，好吗？

ex.en: Comparing food prices per kilo can help households manage their budgets and make more economical purchasing decisions.
ex.zh: 比较食品每公斤的价格，有助于家庭管理预算，作出更经济的购买决定。

col: a kilo of rice｜一公斤大米
tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。kilo通常是kilogram的简称，不指公里。
📘 8B Unit 1

ex.en: We sat on a flat rock beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们坐在河边一块平坦的岩石上。

ex.en: Studying ancient rock layers helps scientists understand how the Earth's climate has changed over time.
ex.zh: 研究古老的岩层有助于科学家了解地球气候随时间发生的变化。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。rock 作岩石材料不可数；指一块石头时可数。

senses.zh: 耗尽；用光；过有效期；失效

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1
📘 8B Unit 1

ex.en: Use a sharp knife to slice the bread.
ex.zh: 用一把锋利的刀把面包切成片。

ex.en: Learning to use a kitchen knife safely is an important part of practical food education.
ex.zh: 学习安全使用菜刀是实用饮食教育的重要组成部分。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。k不发音；复数把-fe变为-ves：knives。

senses.zh: 用小刀切；刀切似的穿过（knife的三单形式）

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1

senses.zh: 削除；截止；截断(退路等)；割下来

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1

ex.en: The nurse took some blood from my arm.
ex.zh: 护士从我的手臂抽了一些血。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can lower blood pressure and reduce the risk of heart disease.
ex.zh: 经常进行体育活动可以降低血压，并减少患心脏病的风险。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。blood通常不可数；一次验血用a blood test。

senses.zh: 平均的；卑鄙的；低劣的；吝啬的

ex.en: I didn't mean to leave you waiting outside.
ex.zh: 我不是故意让你在外面等着的。

ex.en: Higher energy prices may mean that low-income households have less money available for other essential needs.
ex.zh: 能源价格上涨可能意味着低收入家庭可用于其他基本需求的钱会更少。

col: mean to do something｜打算做某事
mean doing something｜意味着做某事
be mean to someone｜对某人刻薄
tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。mean to do是“打算做”；mean doing是“意味着做”。

senses.zh: 逐渐放弃(恶习)；避免；由…出来；拔出

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1

ex.en: Losing my keys taught me the importance of a spare.
ex.zh: 丢了钥匙后，我才明白备用钥匙有多重要。

ex.en: Schools should emphasise the importance of critical thinking rather than focusing only on examination results.
ex.zh: 学校应强调批判性思维的重要性，而不是只关注考试成绩。

col: recognise the importance of｜认识到……的重要性
tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。importance不可数；重视某事用attach importance to。
